title: Rollers closer
description: A charcoal textured band holding two cards side by side: an orange card whose client quotes (headline, paragraph, round avatar, name and company) slide sideways every six seconds with dots to pick one, and a wide white card with a chip, a centred very large two-tone heading, an orange paragraph and a pill + rectangle button pair. Stacked on phones.
notes: autoplay pauses on hover and is off under reduced motion
dark in both modes: it uses the theme's .dark palette; the white card is drawn with foreground/background inside it
avatar is a placeholder circle with initials until you pass an
